thumb|[[Ipomoea tricolor (botany)|Ipomoea tricolor (Mexican morning glory) it is typically an annual plant, but can also be biennial.]]
In botany, an annual plant is a plant that has a life cycle (the germination of its seeds to its flowering) within a year.
